ios.desc:
Magic Lasso Adblock is the fastest, most efficient Safari, YouTube, App and Apple TV ad blocker available.

400,000+ users rely on Magic Lasso Adblock to:

• Block ads and trackers – Block ads in Safari, YouTube, Apps and more
• Browse 2.0x faster – Experience distraction free, faster web browsing
• Protect your privacy – Block trackers to surf safe and sound
• Support for all your devices – A native app for all your devices: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV

“It works and feels as if Apple themselves had designed an ad blocker.” - John Gruber, Daring Fireball

▶ Safari Ad Blocking – Fast, Private & Native
Block ads and trackers directly in Safari for a better web experience.
• 2.0x Speed – Cut down on ads and trackers to load websites 2x faster and use less data
• Block Annoyances – Block annoying cookie notices and privacy prompts
• Block Trackers – Improve your privacy and stop being followed by ads around the web
• Regional Ad Blocking – Block ads in over 40 different regions and languages
• Battery Boost – Double battery life by blocking nefarious JavaScript and crypto mining scripts
• Performance Insights – Visualise ad blocking speed, energy efficiency and data savings for any site
• Custom Rules – Create your own rules to stop cookies, media and JavaScript
• Tap to Block – Block any element on a page or site with a simple tap

“Magic Lasso couldn’t be easier to set up or use. Pages immediately load faster and read better.” - Nathan Alderman, iMore

▶ YouTube Ad Blocking – Watch Without Interruptions
Enjoy a cleaner YouTube experience in Safari.
• Block all YouTube video ads – Including pre-roll and mid-roll video ads
• Block 10+ other YouTube ads – Including banner ads, search ads, paid merchandising ads & more
• Works on all YouTube videos – Blocks ads in mobile, desktop and embedded videos
• Continually updated and supported to work with the latest YouTube changes 

▶ App Ad Blocking – Ads Gone from Your Apps and Apple TV
• Block ads in Games, Video, News & Social apps
• Block ads in Chrome, Firefox and other web browsers
• Watch your favourite TV shows with less interruptions on your Apple TV
• Protect your privacy from in-app ad tracking
• Improve your network speed with faster DNS performance
• On-device Ad Blocking – Block ads without data leaving your device
• Zero Data Collection – We don't collect, track or access your data or browsing history

▶  Apple Native, Fully Supported & Continually Updated
• Native Ad Blocker – Supports iPhone, iPad

quotes.text:
> "blocking ads and trackers" on the phone means that there's basically only one choice which is firefox, no? not saying firefox is not good but it's at least not for everyone.

I'm blocking a good percentage of ads in Safari on my iPhone via third-party apps Hush[0] and Magic Lasso[1]. I typically read articles in Reader mode. Because of this, I can't give a great accounting of how many ads actually get through. Certainly, the number is small enough that I don't think about it.

[0] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hush-nag-blocker/id1544743900
[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ad-blocker-by-magic-lasso/id1260462853
